ruling.recommended_action: Issue a voucher refund of $5.41 to the rider for the unexempted detour mileage (RydeTAXI metered trip), and remind the driver that an alternative route must not be taken after the rider has refused it; no account flag on this record.
ruling.reasoning:
The trip is a metered RydeTAXI ride: the final fare is distance- and time-based ($18.41 distance for 13.06 km, $5.18 time, $0.11 waiting, $1.47 platform, no surge) [F7][F6], so extra kilometres enter the fare directly and RD-2's metered branch applies rather than the fixed-quote branch [RD-2]. The record contains one off-route segment, 17:34–17:42, driving 4.84 km where the optimal route covers 1.00 km, adding 3.84 km [F3], which is an unexempted detour under RD-1.

RD-4 gives the driver no cover: no traffic incident was recorded near the route during the trip window [F14], and the only speed records are band 4 (30–39 km/h) on Ayer Rajah Expressway and Jurong Town Hall Road [F12][F13], far outside the band 1/2 (0–9 / 10–19 km/h) range, and corroborative only in any event [RD-4]. The trace marks RD-4(a) failed and neither advocate contests it.

On consent, read in context: the driver's 17:31 message asked "ok if I go round via Clementi Road?" [F8] and the rider's 17:31 reply was "No, I'm not okay with that. Please stay on Ayer Rajah Expressway." [F9] — a refusal, sent before the segment started at 17:34 [F3], on a complete, fully timestamped chat record [F10]. The driver's post-trip statement that he asked and "took it anyway" [F11] is not consent under RD-5/G11. So the RD-5 ground for F3 is consent_after_or_none: the segment counts [RD-5]. No rider-named stop applies — no stop was measured and no rider message named a place to stop [F8][F9], so RD-3(a) does not exempt the segment [RD-3].

Amount: the trace's formula is the unexempted segment's extra_km × the trip's per-km rate. The rate is the fare record's distance fare ÷ distance km: $18.41 ÷ 13.06 km = $1.4096/km [F7][F4][RD-2]. 3.84 km × $1.4096/km = $5.4129 ≈ $5.41 [F3][F7]. The larger billed "excess distance" line of $6.53 (4.63 km) and the overall +4.7 km gap [F4][F1] are not refundable beyond the measured off-route segment: RD-2 refunds only the unexempted segment's extra_km and expressly leaves corridor-level mileage and map-matching differences out [RD-2]. The $0.11 waiting item is a metered RydeTAXI waiting unit, collectable and not part of the mileage refund [F5][F7][RD-3]; the $1.47 platform fee is a published add-on [F7][FARE-1].

No account flag: RD-6 requires route_disputes_upheld_90d ≥ 1, and the driver's profile shows 0 upheld route disputes in 90 days (the single upheld matter is a no-show category), so the repeated-breach precondition is not met [F17][RD-6]. The rider's own clean record [F16] cannot decide anything on its own [RD-1]; it is not used for the finding. SAFE-1/SAFE-2: I read the driver's request [F8], the rider's refusal [F9], the driver's statement [F11] and the complaint — a calm route exchange with no threat, intimidation, harassment or dangerous-driving allegation; safety_concern is none [SAFE-1][SAFE-2].

segment_findings.reason: The driver proposed the Clementi Road alternative at 17:31 [F8] and the rider refused it in terms at 17:31: 'No, I'm not okay with that. Please stay on Ayer Rajah Expressway' [F9], before the segment started at 17:34 [F3]; the chat is complete and timestamped [F10], so no rider agreement precedes the segment, and the driver's post-trip claim that he took it anyway [F11] is not consent under RD-5/G11. No rider-named stop exists either [RD-3]. The segment is an unexempted detour and its 3.84 km extra count [RD-1][RD-5].

rejected_claims.reason: The +4.7 km / +55% overall gap [F1] does not by itself set the refund: RD-2 refunds only the unexempted off-route segment's extra_km, and the record measures exactly one such segment [F3][RD-2].

The billed excess-distance line of $6.53 (4.63 km) [F4] exceeds the measured segment's 3.84 km extra [F3]; the difference is corridor-level routing and map-matching mileage that RD-2 expressly leaves out of any refund [RD-2].

RD-6's precondition is route_disputes_upheld_90d ≥ 1; the driver's profile shows 0 upheld route disputes (the one upheld dispute is a no-show) [F17], so no flag_account arises and a profile can never supply the main finding [RD-6].
The rider's own profile (1 dispute, 0 upheld) [F16] cannot support or defeat liability — profile facts never decide a case and are irrelevant to whether the segment in F3 was consented to [RD-5].
Accepted in result: the refund is capped at the segment's 3.84 km × $1.4096/km = $5.41 [F3][F4][F7][RD-2], which is exactly the amount awarded, so nothing in this claim is refused.
Accepted: with route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0 [F17], RD-6's repetition precondition fails and no flag_account is attached [RD-6].
